I spent my life getting nauseas after some meals and experiencing bloating and stomach pain which my parents always boiled down to me not wanting to eat and wasting food. When I turned 16 we went to a market and purchased street food and that evening I experienced the most severe pain I’ve felt in my life, I was vomiting, burping, fever, shivers, sweating, dizziness and stomach cramps that we so sharp it felt as if cutting the guts out would be less painful. 
Initially we boiled it down to food poisoning and moved on. A month later, it happened again and after the same food and same market, I didn’t pick up on the connection. Then I had a braai (barbeque) with a sausage called boerewors and had the same symptoms pop up. Still didn’t link it. I had around a year of intermittent unpredictable episodes of this pain before I finally clicked. Everything I had eaten prior to the episode contained pork. I tested my hypothesis by intentionally eating pork and triggered an episode.
I’ve since excluded pork from my diet and apart from accidental ingestion or cross contamination at fast food trucks I haven’t had the episodes.
Thinking back to my childhood, the nausea and stomach aches were always linked to my favorite foods, a pizza with ham on it, pork ribs, salami, carbanossi (cured pork sausage) etc.
At 16 my body just kicked an intolerance I always had into overdrive and now I’m unable to touch the stuff. Always listen to your body and listen to your kids, I had years of discomfort because my symptoms weren’t understood (my parents are amazing and this is not to discredit them, they are not doctors). Always listen to your gut, you’ll be better for it
